observation.visible_scene: A tight, fixed close-up of a pile of burning wood: several charred, dark-brown to black logs arranged diagonally and vertically, with bright orange glowing embers visible in the gaps between them and white-to-yellow flames licking up around the logs. A prominent near-vertical split log sits left of center, a rounded log lies diagonally across the lower middle, and more blackened logs fill the right side. The scene is dominated by active fire.
visible_changes: The logs themselves hold their positions throughout the excerpt; comparing the first and last frames, the arrangement of the vertical, diagonal and rounded logs is unchanged, so no log translation, collapse or sliding is visible.

The flames flicker continuously: the bright white flame tongues at the base of the vertical log and along the bottom edge curl, thin out, and reform from frame to frame, changing shape and height without any single start or stop.
The intensity and extent of the orange glow in the gaps between logs vary subtly, brightening and dimming as the fire burns.
Intermittent blue-tinted flame appears at the lower portion of the vertical log in several mid-to-late frames.
Pale wispy smoke/steam on the right side drifts upward and shifts shape over time.
The overall brightness and coverage of the white-yellow flames rise and fall in a flickering, ongoing manner rather than growing or dying out within the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was lit and what preceded this excerpt is not shown.
Whether the logs eventually shift, collapse or burn down is unknown beyond the crop.
The fuel type and setting (fireplace, campfire, etc.) are not visible.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is uncertain; the framing of the logs stays very consistent, so any apparent movement is most likely flame flicker rather than a pan or zoom, but a slight handheld drift cannot be fully ruled out.
It is unclear whether the pale wisps on the right are smoke, steam or flame glow, and whether small bright spots are reflections or separate burning bits.
